decisions.reason: Requiring a draft copyright-transfer certificate with sufficient wording does not change the logo artwork's originality or permitted role of the AI-generated inspiration draft.
The certificate review request does not change the required PNG exports or their file-opening acceptance condition.
The copyright-certificate wording request does not affect the flame-based letter O or its recognition requirement.
Reviewing a draft copyright certificate does not alter the completed concept-development obligations or the originality expected of the concepts.
The requested certificate concerns copyright ownership and does not change the required brand font details or complementary font recommendations.
The certificate acceptance condition does not change the specified full-colour, black, and white logo variants.
The copyright-certificate request does not change the separate disclosure of whether the logo lettering uses an existing font or is custom-made.
The certificate wording mentioned in the source is documentary language and does not alter the company name, excluded logo word, or brand representation.
The request to inspect certificate wording does not change whether the existing strapline must appear in the logo.
The copyright certificate is separate from the brand colour details and does not change the colour-code documentation requirement.
The certificate review condition does not alter the approved graduated-orange and black colour treatment of the logo.
Requesting a draft copyright-transfer certificate does not change the obligation to provide editable logo source files or their intended applications.
